description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mardu Warshrieker, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Mardu Warshrieker from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Mardu Warshrieker enters the battlefield, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.
